description: No workflow scoping — a cached response for workflow A could replay onto workflow B for the same (key · actor) tuple. In practice mobile clients mint UUID keys per submission so real-world collisions are rare · but the pattern is unsafe by design and hostile to shared/enterprise client integrations.
fix: Added `workflow: str = \"_default\"` kwarg to `with_idempotency` and made unique index tuple `(key · actor_id · workflow)`. Legacy `key_actor_uniq` index dropped and existing 204 rows backfilled with workflow=_default so the new index can be built without rejection.

description: No stale-sentinel recovery — a factory owner that crashes mid-execution leaves an in_flight sentinel that blocks all future callers (they poll for 10s then fall through · but the sentinel itself is never cleaned up until the 90-day TTL expires). Subsequent retries thus race the fallback path.
fix: Added _STALE_SENTINEL_SECONDS=90 window. On duplicate-key insert · pollers examine the sentinel's created_at and reclaim it (delete + fall through) once past the window.

description: (inherited from TRACK 22.4b-followup-DR) Concurrent same-key requests both executed the factory · creating duplicate DR rows and duplicate Trust Spine events. Fix was landed in the prior track; this track certified the fix generalizes to every workflow that adopts the helper.

`POST /api/meetings` had NO idempotency protection at all. B-02 was just closed for meetings but a concurrent retry could still create duplicate meetings + duplicate notifications + duplicate Trust Spine record_created events.
fix: Wrapped create_meeting body in `_do_create` and called `with_idempotency(db · key · {\"role\":\"public\"} · _do_create · workflow=\"meeting\")`.

description: `POST /api/inspections` has no idempotency protection. Not directly exercised in this preview cycle · but is a high-volume field submit and should adopt the helper.
fix: DEFERRED to a follow-up track. Endpoint remains behind rate_limit_public_post so double-click risk is bounded · but the concurrency race window still exists in principle.
